text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On the day of the Satsuki Sho, a Classic race that can be run only once in a lifetime…

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I'm so overwhelmed… I can't believe I'm actually running in the Classics.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: These racers are the cream of the crop who dedicated all they have to compete here…

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hehe! I guess that means it's the perfect place for me to unleash my mad skills! ♪
choice_data_list: Show them what you can do!
Show them what you can do!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: All righty! I'll put the pedal to the metal!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's ready to give the other runners another goal to chase as the gates of the Satsuki Sho fly open!
